patch_description: Following the recommendation, clone the full ZZ entangling sequence (nearest-neighbor ring + opposite-qubit couplings + skip-2 shell), all sharing the same "zz_ring" parameter, immediately after the first pass. This increases circuit depth/expressivity without adding any new trainable parameters, which previously gave a small score lift (+0.01 in gen 37). The added entangling depth should help improve worst-group margin/separation for harder samples while keeping parameter economy intact (still only 3 distinct parameter names).
